question: Which singer was honoured with the Icon Award at 2021 Billboard Music Awards in May 2021?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Pink**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Singer Pink **was honoured with the** Icon Award at the 2021 Billboard Music Awards in May 2021.**
 
• At the 2021 Billboard Music Awards, singer Pink received the Icon Award **(BBMAs).**
 
• The prize aims to honour musicians who have made an enduring contribution to music while enjoying success on the Billboard charts.
 
• Along with Neil Diamond, Stevie Wonder, Prince, Jennifer Lopez, Celine Dion, Cher, Janet Jackson, Mariah Carey, and Garth Brooks, Pink is the latest honoree.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

__
 
• **Pink (stylized as Pink) **is the stage name of **Alecia Beth Moore, an American singer, songwriter, actress, and dancer.**
 
• She formerly belonged to the female group Choice. Pink received a solo recording contract from LaFace Records in 1995 when they recognised her talent.
 
• Her R&B-influenced debut studio album **Can't Take Me Home (2000)** earned double platinum status in the US and produced the top ten singles "There You Go" and "Most Girls" on the Billboard Hot 100. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• **At the Microsoft Theater in Los Angeles, California**, on May 23, 2021,** the 2021 Billboard Music Awards** were presented. Nick Jonas served as the ceremony's host, and it was live-streamed from NBC.
 
• On April 28, 2021, the finalists for the Top Hot 100 Artist, Top Latin Male Artist, and Top Rap Female Artist awards were revealed. On April 29, 2021, the entire list of nominations was announced.
 
• **Mariah Carey** is an American actress, singer, songwriter, record producer, and actress.
 
 
• She is recognised for her five-octave vocal range, melismatic singing style, and distinctive usage of the whistle register.
 
• She is also referred to as the "Songbird Supreme" and the "Queen of Christmas."
 
 
 
• **J.Lo, commonly referred to as Jennifer Lynn Lopez**, is an American dancer, actor, and singer.
 
• American country music performer and songwriter** Troyal Garth Brooks.**
